_comment: Copy to notify_config.json (gitignored) and fill in. Never put a password in the tracked example file. Every key here is optional - notify.py falls back to the DEFAULTS in its own source.
_transport: Elastic Email is what the pgishonim system already sends through, so the account exists and pgishonim.com is a verified sender. For Zoho instead: smtp.zoho.com / 465 / "ssl", and an app-specific password.
_credentials: Leave smtp_user/smtp_password empty and point env_file at an existing .env - the notifier reads the two keys out of it at send time, so no secret is ever stored in this project.
_behaviour: daily_digest sends a summary even on days with zero strong buys, so a quiet inbox proves the scan ran. realert_days stops the same ticker alerting on each of the 2-3 scans it stays prime for.
